description: SEC EDGAR company facts (revenue, net income, EPS, shares, cash, debt) and ticker-to-CIK mapping for one US ticker. Not endorsed by the SEC. Price: 30 sats (Lightning) or $0.025 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"stock_fundamentals","data":{"company":{"ticker":"NVDA","cik":"0001045810","name":"NVIDIA CORP"},"metrics":{"revenue":{"value":60922000000,"unit":"USD","end":"2025-01-26","form":"10-K"},"net_income":{"value":29760000000,"unit":"USD"},"eps":{"value":1.19,"unit":"USD / shares"}}},"metadata":{"cost_sats":30}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

symbol.description: US ticker. EDGAR accepts any symbol in the SEC company_tickers.json map (featured: SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL, AMD, AVGO, MU, PLTR, NBIS, CRWV, RKLB, INTC, ASTS, HIMS, TSM, SOFI, ORCL, HOOD, NFLX, SMCI, COIN, MSTR, IBIT, MARA, GME).

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: get_stock_fundamentals
title: SEC EDGAR fundamentals (30 sats L402 or $0.025 USDC x402)
